'''Melvin Ray Sanders''' (born January 3, 1981) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played for the [[National Basketball Association]]'s [[San Antonio Spurs]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/spurs/news/transactions_051109.html Spurs Sign Melvin Sanders]</ref><ref>[https://www.espn.com/nba/team/transactions/_/name/sa/san-antonio-spurs San Antonio Spurs Transactions 2005-06]</ref>

==Professional career==
A graduate of [[Oklahoma State University - Stillwater|Oklahoma State University]], Sanders, a [[shooting guard|guard]] and [[small forward|forward]], played for [[Pallacanestro Varese|Varese]] in the [[Serie A (basketball)|Italian league]] and [[Telindus Oostende]] in [[Belgium]],<ref name=unicaja/> the [[Dakota Wizards]] of the [[Continental Basketball Association]] (CBA),<ref name=Kalise/> and the [[NBA Development League]]'s [[Fayetteville Patriots]]. He earned All-CBA Second Team and All-Defensive Team honors with the Wizards in 2005.<ref>{{cite web |title=Melvin Sanders minor league basketball statistics |url=https://www.statscrew.com/minorbasketball/stats/p-sandemel001 |website=Stats Crew |access-date=June 23, 2021}}</ref> During the [[2005-06 NBA season]], he signed 10-day contract stints with the [[San Antonio Spurs]].  After his fourth such contract (including training camp) expired, on March 26, 2006, the Spurs signed Sanders for the remainder of the season.

On January 9, 2007, he signed a contract with [[Élan Béarnais Pau-Orthez|Pau-Orthez]] of the [[Ligue Nationale de Basketball|French League]].<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/6035/180/pau-orthez-signs-guard-melvin-sanders?smid=277 Pau-Orthez signs guard Melvin Sanders]</ref> He averaged 10.5 points, 3.3 rebounds and 1.2 steals in 10 Euroleague games, and also helped Pau win the French Cup.<ref name=Panellinios/> On July 20, 2007, Sanders signed with [[Panellinios BC|Panellinios]] of the [[A1 Ethniki|Greek League]].<ref name=Panellinios>[http://www.euroleague.net/ulebcup/home/news/i/14549/448/item Panellinios tabs Melvin Sanders]</ref> However, in mid-December 2007 he was brought out of his contract by one of the top clubs in the ACB Unicaja Malaga<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/ulebcup/home/news/i/21361/448/item Panellinios picks up Damir Rancic, drops Sanders]</ref> after seeing limited action due to a broken [[clavicle|collarbone]] sustained in a car accident during the preseason.<ref name=unicaja/>

On December 25, 2007, he signed with [[CB Málaga|Unicaja]] of the [[Asociación de Clubs de Baloncesto|Spanish ACB]].<ref name=unicaja>[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/21391/180/unicaja-adds-guard-melvin-sanders Unicaja adds guard Melvin Sanders]</ref> On July 10, 2008, Sanders was signed by [[CB Gran Canaria|Kalise Gran Canaria]] of the ACB.<ref name=Kalise>[http://www.euroleague.net/ulebcup/home/news/i/33793/448/item Kalise Gran Canaria inks Melvin Sanders]</ref>

He signed with [[BC Minsk-2006]] in September 2010.<ref name="Three rookies">[http://www.radiobelarus.tvr.by/eng/news.asp?type=cont&id=18877&date=14.09.2010 Three rookies from the USA and St. Vincent and Grenadine will reinforce basketball club "Minsk 2006"]</ref> In February 2011, he signed with [[Menorca Bàsquet]].<ref>[http://www.menorcabasquet.com/noticia/2011-02-14/melvin-sanders-sincorpora Melvin Sanders s'incorpora] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110714072306/http://www.menorcabasquet.com/noticia/2011-02-14/melvin-sanders-sincorpora |date=2011-07-14 }} {{in lang|es}}</ref> Later that year, he signed with [[Hacettepe Üniversitesi B.K.|Hacettepe Üniversitesi]] of the [[Turkish Basketball League]].

In August 2012, he signed with Basket Barcellona of the Italian Second League.<ref>[http://www.legaduebasket.it/news/?id=119761 Sanders a Barcellona, l'Orlandina firma George]</ref> On March 6, 2013, he signed a contract with [[Pınar Karşıyaka]] for the remainder of that season.<ref>[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/turkey/52107/melvin-sanders-signs-with-pinar-karsiyaka.html Melvin Sanders signs with Pinar Karsiyaka]</ref>

In December 2013, Sanders signed with [[CB Valladolid]] and left the team on 21 January 2014 because of non-payment from the club.<ref>[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=100695 Sanders escapes from CB Valladolid] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140122065441/http://acb.com/redaccion.php?id=100695 |date=2014-01-22 }}; ACB.com 21 January 2014 {{in lang|es}}</ref>
